title: Keto Herb Stuffed Vegetables
description: Delicious stuffed vegetables filled with a flavorful keto herb mixture, perfect for a low-carb dinner.
instructions: Cut the tops off the zucchini and bell peppers, and scoop out the seeds.
In a bowl, mix together the onion, garlic, herb, and jerk seasoning.
Stuff each vegetable with the onion mixture, dividing it evenly.
Place the stuffed vegetables on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender.
Top each vegetable with gooey cheese and return to the oven for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
